Irene — thanks for the note and the PDF. We got the invoice in our system. A couple of quick items:

- Our AP team needs a PO to route payment via ACH. Can you confirm the PO number for this invoice?
- If ACH is acceptable, please provide Redwood's bank account details (we need beneficiary name, routing, and account number). If you prefer wire, AP needs the SWIFT and the intermediary bank info.
- VAT extract: we can provide the VAT registration document. Expect a short delay — AP is verifying format for our tax team but I’ll push to have it uploaded by Thursday.

Can we do net-30? We generally run weekly payment files on Tuesdays, so if the invoice posts this week we’d capture it in the 7 Dec payment run. If you need an earlier window we can escalate.
